dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: How do you do, honored guest? Forgive me for being indisposed to serve you at the moment. I am... waiting for someone.

dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: I am waiting for my lover. His name is Chaoxi, and he is a brilliant sailor.

dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: Mr. Chao always tells stories of his adventures. The last time, he talked about a duel with a giant sea creature, and before that, he told us about the time he destroyed a pirate crew by himself...

dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: His stories truly are spellbinding. I only wish I were there to experience those magnificent events alongside him...

dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: Regardless, we have made a pact, that when next we meet, he will take me away from here...

dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: Though waiting like this is torment, my heart is already set on him, and so I will continue waiting...

dialogues.speaker: Cui'er
dialogues.text: Please, enjoy yourself to the fullest.
